title: Perrin's Mother quest never recognizes that I had already met and talked to Perrin in person at Highward's barracks (he told me he's alive and weighing desertion). Back at Reedholm the only dialogue is 'ask Perrin's mother: tell her you've no word yet', repeatable, with no option to relay what I actually know.
where: Reedholm — the Landing / talk to Perrin's mother
